summary: The global marketing team is driving search/AI visibility for China programs (Asia Star and Intelligent China) while finalizing the Knowledge website redesign and resolving an email lockout.
summaryDetail: The top priority is the seven-month push to secure top-five search/AI rankings for Asia Star and the new Intelligent China program, with Berkeley as a possible third focus; this requires Joseph's prompt/audience draft and representative customer profiles to be built from Asia Star participants and CRM leads. This week, the team must also resolve the Outlook account lockout by re-logging in and updating passwords across all devices, and confirm the backend unlock with JSB. The Knowledge website redesign is moving forward: Joseph will share the HTML concept, a 30-minute feedback session will be held, and Joker will implement design changes, while the team finalizes the conversion tracking brief. Looking ahead, the Knowledge site launch needs final tweaks and outstanding items addressed, and there are upcoming tasks like updating award status in the press release and posting the final English obituary for Professor Jon Liao.

decisions.text: Re-login and update passwords across all devices to prevent repeated lockouts.
Remove the standalone videos section and disperse videos by topic across the site.
Keep the current knowledge design largely as-is, with menu categorization as the main change.
Bring BCI and BSI indices into the knowledge section, similar to the school homepage banner.
Do not add a stock-market ticker at the top of the homepage.
Use Joseph's editorial layout as inspiration to display more articles, not to be followed exactly.
Prioritize Asia Star and Intelligent China as top two programs; put US partnerships on hold initially.
Consider Berkeley as a third priority and include it in the audit phase.
Target top-five search/AI visibility for China programs within seven months rather than number one.
No need to involve legal over the PRME data security incident as no real damage occurred; change password once platform is fixed
